source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. A misty haunted manor, bell-sunken marsh and ghost ship: eerie, haunted and melancholic waltz, candle flames flickering, sad rather than violent. Tempo 72 BPM, 3/4 time, key of C minor. Instrumentation: harpsichord and clarinet, slightly broken-sounding music box, distant bell, low strings, soft ghostly pad. Form: music-box intro, waltz theme, darker middle, return. Duration: 75 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
